experiments.scope: Constructibility of the variant dense parts and detection by the counted program (proof.md Sections 4.3, 7.4 and 13.2): it supports H2 only by showing that variants of the family reach full 37-step semi-free-start collisions, and the Step-1 charge A_S only through the completion of a Step-1 solution; it estimates no probability. experiments/lowm.py embeds the outputs of the charged constructions (the pair and S of A_S, L*, the c7 values of the 1,067 classes of the preprocessing) and derives each class it uses from its c7 value (fibre, Lemma 5.3). Trial t < 8 chooses (from SHAKE-256 of the seed) a variant a0 of class (7 t mod 1067), imposes pattern 4 + (t mod 4) (R16x: E16[23] = 1) and an l of the 44, and builds a 37-step semi-free-start collision whose second-block state uses the variant (rows 16..21 by proposals with each row's fixed x-bits of E imposed, restarting from row 16 after 2^11 proposals at a row; W22 by proposals with W7 drawn exactly from F7 and W6 accepted iff in F6; rows 22..36 replayed with the variant's W8, accepted iff the eight registers agree after step 36; the tail proposals of all trials share a budget of 2^20; W0..W5 by the inverse expansion; CV1 by inverting steps 7..0). A trial returns CV1||M1 and CV1||M1' (96 bytes each) iff: the Step-2 equations of (CV1, a0) give exactly W0..W13 of both members, the two 37-step outputs are equal, M1 != M1', every signed cell of rows -4..21 (W6/W7 XOR cells excepted) and every printed two-bit condition of rows 15..21 holds, a0 is in G and in its class, and W8 differs from S's. Each returned pair is fed to the counted online program with the class test restricted to the class of a0, which must find exactly the constructed pair (observation detected_by_counted_program). Trials 8..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: those of trials 0..7 that complete within the shared proposal budget (several, not all). Full collisions of the complete target: 0 (these are semi-free-start collisions from CV1, not from the IV; anyone can verify them offline with the 37-step compression). This tests that A0-variants of S (proof.md Lemmas 4.2, 4.3) are valid dense parts that reach full 37-step semi-free-start collisions through every cell of rows 16..21 with their own W8, for each of the four R16x patterns, and that the counted program finds exactly the constructed pair. It does not estimate q3. Observations (participant numbers): class_index, variant_index, l, pattern, checks_passed, restarts, proposals_row16, proposals_tail, detected_by_counted_program, counted_ops.

experiments.scope: Functional exactness only: H5, Lemmas 6.2 and 8.1 (proof.md Sections 6, 8, 9 and 13.2); a consistency check, not a test, of H1. The counted online program (proof.md Section 8.2) on seed-drawn first blocks (two uniform words from SHAKE-256 of the seed per first block; real 37-step compressions) with all 1,067 classes, until a first block has a passing class (at most 64 first blocks), restricted to the first three passing classes of that block for time: the W7 class test of all 1,067 classes (five batches), the W6 programs, the scan, the packed addresses, the two-table probe and the exact row-16 test of every probed lane, rows 17..36 for every row-16 pass. Every lane of the class-test planes is checked against the scalar F7 test, every lane of every pass plane against the scalar F6 test of the member, the set of good pairs against the brute-force definition over all variants of the processed classes, the address u of every probed lane against W0 + s0(W1) from the step equations, the table stage and the exact test against the row-16 definition (every lane with a survivor and every 16th lane, for all 44 l), and up to 12 good pairs against every cell of rows -4..15 for all 44 elements of L*. A trial returns the complete 128-byte messages M0||M1 and M0||M1' (l = 13) of its first good pair iff all checks passed. Trials 8..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Full collisions: 0 (rows 16..36 are not expected to hold). Mismatches of every kind: 0. Returned pairs: those trials whose first block with a passing class had a good pair. Observations (participant numbers): first_blocks, classes, good_pairs, groups, survivors, row16_pairs, counted_ops, class_lane_mismatches, pass_lane_mismatches, goodset_mismatches, address_mismatches, row16_mismatches, cell_mismatches, pairs_cell_checked. This tests the correctness of the bit-sliced class and W6 programs, of the packed address and of the row-16 stage (Lemma 6.2) on organizer-seeded first blocks; it does not test q3, H1 at scale or H3.

experiments.scope: A program check of the H1 consequence that the W7 class filter and the W6 filter pass at their exact rates on real 37-step chaining values (proof.md Section 5.1, Lemma 5.1, Appendix H.7). Per trial, 150 first blocks from the organizer's trial seed; for the first class (c7 = 716a554f) and four of its variants it counts how often W7x is in F7 and W6x is in F6 (definition form). No pair is returned, so the event full-collision never succeeds by design; the counts are participant observations, which the organizer report does not use. It estimates no probability, says nothing about q3, rows 16 and later, independence across 2^51.7 first blocks or cost, and no statistic is claimed.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0. Full collisions: 0. Observations (participant numbers): blocks, w7, w6, coW6, w7_and_w6, w7_w6_pairs. If H1 holds the expected counts per 150 blocks are about 150 x 2^-5.98 = 2.4 for w7 and 4 x 150 x 2^-3.90 = 40 for w6; the program was cross-checked against experiments/lowm.py on two trials (identical counts). The seeds are the organizer's own and no seed was chosen or selected by us.

experiments.scope: A program check at the W6 level of the H3 consequence that distinct variants of one class are not unusually dependent within one first block (proof.md Section 10, Appendix H.7): the same program and trials as h1-cv1-filters-nonce; the observation coW6 counts first blocks in which two or more of the four variants pass F6. It does not test row 16 or any later row, where H3 has its weight, and cannot show H3 at full scale. No pair is returned; the counts are participant observations that the organizer report does not use; no statistic is claimed.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0. Full collisions: 0. Observation coW6 (and w7_w6_pairs) per 150 first blocks; if the four variants passed F6 independently (each with probability 2^-3.90) about 150 x 0.0245 = 3.7 first blocks per trial would have two or more passes. The four variants of one class share most of their bits, so a clearly higher count is expected (about 3.9 times that in our local replay); it measures the within-class correlation of the W6 filter, which the ledger does not need (it uses only expectations), and is not a test of success events. The program is the same as in h1-cv1-filters-nonce.
